coverage.target: NFR1.1, NFR1.2, NFR1.3 — FeedUnit is NFR1's primary owner (the feed-load-time requirement is specifically this Unit's listPosts request path)
NFR3 (payment-data handling) belongs to donation-unit; FeedUnit has no payment surface
NFR4.1 (data protection — Post content is public; createdByGoogleId is the only personal-data field)
NFR6.1 (services/-layer access boundary and mandatory self-review before merging admin-authorization changes)
Accessibility (WCAG AA baseline) is a UI-rendering concern owned by flutter-app-unit; FeedUnit has no UI of its own
Testing methodology/coverage floor is a cross-cutting Build and Test concern, not a Unit-level NFR target

note: scalability-requirements.md (NFR-SC.1) and observability-requirements.md (NFR-OBS.1-4) are intentionally outside the NFR1-NFR8 inheritance chain above: inception's requirements.md defines no scalability or observability NFR for this project, so both files use Unit-local IDs rather than a fabricated inception sub-ID, consistent with the discipline established at auth-unit's NFR review (R-06) and donation-unit's NFR pass.
